dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Hehe. It seems that the Truesight Potion has been marvelously successful. I think that quite a few enhanced formulas can be made, too... Vere can decide their exact proportions, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Carabosse
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is it? Would you like any potions made by yours truly?
